m.e: Her skin is soft.

m.d: The outer layer of a fruit or vegetable; a peel.

If you skin something, you remove its skin.

m.e: I go to a class every weekend to help me improve on my writing skills.

m.d: A skinny is a person who has not enough flesh, enough muscle, whose body appears to be too thin and narrow.

m.d: A skinny person or animal has few flesh or muscle around the skeleton, he/she/it has a thin and narrow body.

m.d: A skirt is a loose cloth that a woman uses to cover her legs; the lower part of a dress.

m.e: The artist made a quick sketch before he started painting the real picture.

m.d: A sketch is a quick description of a person, or of something that happened.
m.e: He gave me a sketch of the incident, stating only the main facts.

m.d: A sketch is a short piece of acting, usually funny.

m.d: If you sketch something, you make a quick drawing of it using a pencil or a pen.
m.e: I sketched his face quickly before he woke up.

m.d: If you sketch something, you describe it without many details.

When you ski, you travel through snow on skis

m.d: A skeleton is the bones that support the body of an animal or person.
A skeleton is a very thin person.
m.e: She lost so much weight while she was sick that she became a skeleton.

m.d: The skeleton of something is the core of it, the part that give it structure.
When someone is skilled, it means they are very good or talented at doing something.
m.e: You seem to be very skilled in sewing! Who taught you so well?

m.d: An ice skate is a steel blade, which are worn on the feet to travel across ice.
A roller skate has wheels, which are worn on the feet, to travel across smooth surfaces.
A skate board is a small piece of wood with wheels on the bottom.
To skate is to travel using roller skates, ice skates, or a skate board.
m.e: I loved to ice skate during the winter.

m.d: Skiing is a sport where people race each other on skis through snow
A skunk is an animal that releases a strong odor when frightened.
If someone is skeptical, they doubt that something is true or correct.
m.e: Many people were skeptical of his claim to have seen a UFO.

m.d: If someone has a skeptical attitude, they question ideas or beliefs rather than accepting them easily.
m.e: The scientist took a skeptical approach and asked for more evidence.

m.d: A skid the act of something sliding out of control.

m.d: A skid is a long, flat piece that is attached under an aircraft that helps the aircraft land.
If a vehicle skids, it slides sideways along a slippery surface, usually in an uncontrollable way.
m.e: The truck skidded out of control on the ice.

m.d: A skateboard is a thin piece of wood with four wheels that you can ride by standing on it and pushing against the ground with your foot.

m.d: If someone skateboards, they use a skateboard for fun or to go to a place.

m.d: If you skim something, you remove a substance from the surface of a liquid.
